name: PRD §6.1: «Активные задачи проекта» (запрос-иллюстрация)
query: aspect=orbis/task, status=!done&!cancelled, excludeBlocked=true, children_of=this, sortBy=priority:desc|due_date:asc, limit=20, display=compact, title=Активные задачи проекта
sql: SELECT id, owner_id, title, emoji, body, body_refs, tags, meta, props, aspects, query_refs, aspects_legacy, created_at, updated_at, archived FROM entities WHERE true AND NOT archived AND NOT (aspects_legacy ?| ARRAY[$1]::text[]) AND aspects_legacy ? $2 AND (aspects_legacy->'orbis/task'->>'status' IS NULL OR aspects_legacy->'orbis/task'->>'status' NOT IN ($3, $4)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relations r JOIN entities b ON b.id = r.source_id WHERE r.target_id = entities.id AND r.role = $5 AND COALESCE(b.aspects_legacy->'orbis/task'->>'status', '') NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled')) AND id IN (SELECT target_id FROM relations WHERE source_id = $6 AND role IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) * FROM relation_role_definitions ORDER BY id, owner_id DESC NULLS LAST) d WHERE d.hierarchical)) ORDER BY CASE aspects_legacy->'orbis/task'->>'priority' WHEN 'low' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 END DESC NULLS LAST, (aspects_legacy->'orbis/task'->>'due_date')::date ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT $7
countSql: SELECT count(*) FROM entities WHERE true AND NOT archived AND NOT (aspects_legacy ?| ARRAY[$1]::text[]) AND aspects_legacy ? $2 AND (aspects_legacy->'orbis/task'->>'status' IS NULL OR aspects_legacy->'orbis/task'->>'status' NOT IN ($3, $4)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relations r JOIN entities b ON b.id = r.source_id WHERE r.target_id = entities.id AND r.role = $5 AND COALESCE(b.aspects_legacy->'orbis/task'->>'status', '') NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled')) AND id IN (SELECT target_id FROM relations WHERE source_id = $6 AND role IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) * FROM relation_role_definitions ORDER BY id, owner_id DESC NULLS LAST) d WHERE d.hierarchical))
